_readme: The cafeteria menu boards' feature slot (CONTRACT Draft 11; cafe-menu.js 1.6.0). An item shows ONLY when reviewStatus is "approved", today (New York) is inside its optional startsOn..endsOn (inclusive), its fields are well formed and no text names a time. Drafts ("draft", "review") and "retired" never show. Rotation, dwell and gap live in board.json menu.features. Steps: work/cafe-menu/proof/enhance-1015/MAINTAIN.md.

items.title: Compliments to the Kitchen
lines: Enjoyed your meal? Let our kitchen team know—a kind word goes a long way.
When you receive a survey, share your dining experience: what you enjoyed and what could be better.
